decisions.rationale: Lead Pelipper/Basculegion rain core overrides sand and punishes physical threats; Grimmsnarl handles Whimsicott Taunt/priority; Garganacl sets rocks and walls. Intended no Mega. Arcanine/Sableye reserved for pivot/Taunt endgame.
decisions.notebook: Rain core beats fast physicals and sand; double Prankster vs Whimsicott; Arcanine Intimidate pivot vs Blastoise; Garganacl rocks/wall. Item spread: Damp Rock, Life Orb, Focus Sash, Sitrus, Leftovers, Mental Herb.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega is Blastoise. Lead Hippowdon and Whimsicott to immediately overwrite Pelipper's rain with Sand Stream and set Prankster Tailwind, neutralizing Basculegion's Swift Swim. Backline Blastoise and Sneasler provide high-output Mega water spread damage and fast offensive pressure to close out the game.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has rain (Pelipper, Basculegion), Prankster support (Grimmsnarl, Sableye), and physical threats (Arcanine-Hisui, Garganacl). Hippowdon sand + Whimsicott Tailwind dismantles their weather speed advantage. Mega Blastoise is the core wincon for special damage.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper Tailwind beats opposing speed control; Basculegion Protect dodges potential spread or priority while rain core sets up for later turns.
Hippowdon uses Rock Slide to pressure Pelipper while Whimsicott sets up Tailwind to flip the speed advantage against Swift Swim Basculegion under Sand.
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs rain with Pelipper and Swift Swim Basculegion. Hippowdon's Sand Stream resets weather. Whimsicott sets Tailwind safely to outspeed Basculegion.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper outspeeds and hits Whimsicott SE with Hurricane; Basculegion faster and hits Hippowdon SE with Wave Crash before potential EQ. Rain not active per state so avoid Hydro accuracy issues on spread.
decisions.notebook: Rain core vs sand; double Prankster pressure on Whimsicott; Garganacl rocks/wall vs physicals; Arcanine pivot planned vs Blastoise.

decisions.rationale: Hippowdon faces severe water pressure from Basculegion and Pelipper under rain (even with Sandstorm up). Switching Hippowdon to Blastoise brings in Mega-eligible water/bulk resistance, while Whimsicott targets Basculegion with Moonblast to pressure the Swift Swim threat.

Pelipper outspeeds nothing relevant; Hurricane 2HKO range on Whimsicott forces answer while Basculegion Wave Crash pressures Blastoise before possible Mega or Spout. Basculegion too low to risk missing priority AquaJet into faster Whimsicott.
Garganacl walls physical threats and sets rocks in sand; Grimmsnarl less ideal vs current board.
decisions.notebook: Rain core vs sand; Garganacl rocks/wall vs physicals; Arcanine pivot planned vs Blastoise; double Prankster pressure on Whimsicott.

decisions.rationale: Both sides have 2 turns of Tailwind remaining. Basculegion is low (35%) and Pelipper is at 54%. Moonblast finishes Basculegion while Blastoise's Ice Beam hits Pelipper for neutral damage or Water Spout pressures both. Whimsicott outspeeds under Tailwind.

Whimsicott fainted, bringing in Sneasler in slot b. Blastoise is at 12% HP under sand. Sneasler outspeeds and pressures incoming threats like Grimmsnarl or Arcanine-Hisui. Pelipper is at 14% HP. Sneasler can use Fake Out or Close Combat.
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs rain with Pelipper and Swift Swim Basculegion. Backline features Grimmsnarl, Arcanine-Hisui, Garganacl, Sableye.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Pelipper)
decisions.rationale: Pelipper 15% cannot risk Sneasler priority or Blastoise Spout; Wide Guard blocks spread and keeps both safe into Tailwind end.

Tailwind expires this turn, and Sneasler outspeeds Pelipper. Pelipper has 14% HP and can be picked off easily by Sneasler's Dire Claw or Blastoise's Ice Beam / Water Spout. Garganacl is weak to Fighting, making Sneasler's Close Combat into Garganacl a high-impact play while Blastoise picks off Pelipper with Ice Beam or damages the field with Water Spout. Mega Evolving Blastoise gives extra bulk and power.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
Wide Guard (your side, including ally Pelipper)
decisions.rationale: Pelipper 9% dies to any Sneasler hit; Protect blocks Fake Out/priority while Wide Guard covers Blastoise spread and Sneasler spread moves; sand chip + low Blastoise HP sets up next KO without risking free loss.
decisions.notebook: Rain vs sand core; Garganacl rocks/wall vs physicals; Arcanine pivot planned vs Blastoise; double Prankster pressure on Whimsicott.

decisions.rationale: Only Grimmsnarl remains; send to one slot to continue series.

Pelipper is at 8% and Garganacl is at 59%. Garganacl used Wide Guard last turn, so it may not protect again successfully or might try to defend. Blastoise Mega Evolving and using Aura Sphere on Garganacl while Sneasler hits Garganacl with Close Combat targets the healthy threat to finish it, or Blastoise pressures Pelipper with Ice Beam if Pelipper doesn't protect.
Sucker Punch on faster Sneasler (likely attacks) KOs or pressures before it moves; Parting Shot alternative if Protect-heavy. Reflect low value vs priority threats. Sand aids nothing here.

Blastoise-Mega is at 1% HP, so Water Spout would be weak, but Aura Sphere or Ice Beam into Grimmsnarl deals solid damage. Sneasler outspeeds Grimmsnarl and hits it super-effectively with Dire Claw (2x), which can also poison it. Alternatively, we can switch Blastoise to Hippowdon to reset weather or Protect, but knocking out Grimmsnarl with Dire Claw plus an attack from Blastoise secures the game.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl has Prankster, Spirit Break, Sucker Punch, Parting Shot, Reflect. Sneasler outspeeds Grimmsnarl.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.
Sucker Punch Sneasler to remove faster threat before it KOs 1% Grimmsnarl; resisted but only option with priority and no better KO line available.

Grimmsnarl is at 1% HP and has Prankster Sucker Punch (+1 priority), which beats Sneasler's unboosted attacks and Hippowdon's speed. Protecting Hippowdon and using Dire Claw into Grimmsnarl lets Sneasler secure the KO while dodging Sucker Punch, or Hippowdon can Protect if Grimmsnarl targets slot a.

reflections.summary: Lost because preview brought rain core (Pelipper/Garganacl) into sand + Sneasler/Whimsicott; four mons had no answer to sand setup or Blastoise-Mega pressure, leading to immediate core collapse.
reflections.adjustment: Next game drop rain lead for Arcanine pivot + different four that handle sand/Sneasler better instead of forcing Pelipper vs Hippowdon.
reflections.notebook: Opponent commits sand with Hippowdon SmoothRock over rain; Sneasler Unburden used aggressively early; double Prankster vs Whimsicott remains key; Arcanine pivot still planned vs Blastoise; prepare sand counter core for game 2.

reflections.summary: The opponent won due to a better endgame position where their Grimmsnarl's Sucker Punch successfully picked off the remaining Sneasler after weather and hazards wore down the team.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Hippowdon earlier or position Mega Blastoise safer to prevent it from getting chipped down into range of opposing priority before sweeping.
reflections.notebook: Grimmsnarl has Prankster, Spirit Break, Sucker Punch, Parting Shot, Reflect. Sneasler outspeeds Grimmsnarl. Pelipper has Drizzle, Hydro Pump, Hurricane, Tailwind, Protect. Garganacl has Purifying Salt, Salt Cure, Recover, Stealth Rock, Wide Guard. Basculegion has Swift Swim, Wave Crash, Last Respects, Aqua Jet, Protect.
